definitions.gloss: visceral fat; fat around internal organs
definitions.explanation: fat that accumulates around internal organs in the abdominal cavity, as opposed to subcutaneous fat under the skin

examples.english: Having a lot of visceral fat makes you prone to metabolic syndrome.

notes:
Fat stored around the internal organs of the abdomen. It is linked more closely to diabetes, high blood pressure and arteriosclerosis than fat under the skin, and a large waist measurement ({腹囲|ふくい}) is its main screening sign in Japanese health checkups, where it is the core criterion for メタボ (metabolic syndrome).
